purpose: Design spec for target resolution, DLID embedding, and ToC build: input/output boundaries, target expansion rules, change-set determination, information acquisition, candidate publication, and write units.
summary: Inputs and outputs of a build, following build stages B-01 to B-09; build never rewrites index target documents
Target resolution: argument combination rules, directory and pattern expansion, exclusion, path normalization, symlinks, Markdown detection
ID check: documents with missing or duplicate IDs are excluded and reported while the build continues
DLID embedding operation: explicit launch, duplicate original confirmation, issuing document and section IDs, writing only DLIDs
DLID issuing: 60-bit random Crockford Base32 12 characters, probabilistic uniqueness, no rollback of verified writes
Change-set determination for documents and sections (added, removed, moved, heading changed, body changed)
Information acquisition: reuse of unchanged document info, AI generation only when needed, script validation
Candidate validation and atomic publication of the ToC; document info finalized per document
Write units using temp file and os.replace; no locking; reference check results are not failures
Completion and rerun: failure reports and re-evaluation from confirmed ToC and current files
tasks: Implementing target expansion and exclusion logic
Designing atomic writes of ToC and document info
Writing tests for target resolution and indexing
title: DES-005 対象確定・DLID 付与・[ToC]構築設計
